notes: No testTestModelMassChargeBalance.m existed and no test calls the function. Hand-built 6-reaction model (charge-only, mass-only, missing-formula, balanced, exchange, biomass reactions); expected element imbalances and charges derived by hand; all 57 lines covered, nothing left behind. CALLEE DEFECT (LEAD DECISION): a model whose reactions are all mass balanced while some charge is not, with no exchange reaction, stops testModelMassChargeBalance. Reproduction (R2025a, 2026-11-23): m = createModel({'R1','R2'}, {'',''}, {'a[c] -> b[c]', 'b[c] -> c[c]'}, 'printLevel', 0); m.metFormulas = {'C';'C';'C'}; m.metCharges = [0;0;1]; m.metNames = {'A';'B';'C'}; testModelMassChargeBalance(m) -> 'Conversion to double from cell is not possible.' at line 83; testModelMassChargeBalance(m, false) -> 'The logical indices contain a true value outside of the array bounds.' at line 113. Root cause: checkMassChargeBalance line 201 returns imBalancedMass = [] (its header documents an nRxn x 1 cell) at the default printLevel 0. The existing entry in test/verifiedTests/reconstruction/testMassChargeBalance/testMassChargeBalance.m already lists LINES 200-202 but describes only printLevel -1/2; if the lead widens it to the [] output at printLevel 0, testModelMassChargeBalance reaches it (every default call, not a recognisable call form) and this row becomes blocked instead of TESTED. Per the brief the function is not quarantined for a callee defect; the input is skipped and the header Purpose says why. Not a defect (nargin contract, VII-D): an explicitly empty biomassReaction ('') raises 'Biomass reaction "" not found in model.'

LEAD DECISION - callers reaching the defects: (1) gene fields not extended: every call whose rule adds a new gene to a model with another gene field (geneNames, proteins, ...), not recognisable in the calling code, so every caller reaches it: addReaction (line 357/359), addMultipleReactions (178), addMultipleReactionsIT (178), addReactionsHH, getOrgansFromHarvey, prepareModelNutrientGeneMCS - addReaction is a hub, so this blocks many functions; note ecoli_core_model has no gene field besides genes, so addReaction on it is unaffected (probe: genes 138 after adding newGene, no other gene-sized field). (2) translation: only addReaction line 359 (systNameList given). (3) rxnGeneMat creation: only calls with addRxnGeneMat true on a model without rxnGeneMat (addReactionsHH passes 0; getOrgansFromHarvey passes 0 as 4th argument geneNameList, not addRxnGeneMat). Lines 93-97 (subfunction convertGeneID) are never called (dead code). Registry regenerated.
